# Version 4.158.0 (Unreleased)
> **GPU and text rendering reliability**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.158.0 incorporates Skia m158 fixes for GPU failure handling, image filtering and glyph bounds. This same-milestone native update does not change managed APIs or generated bindings.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **GPU error handling** — Propagates Ganesh draw and upload failures and abandons the context when recovery is unsafe. Failed promise-image fulfillment drops the flush's work without abandoning the context. Imagination Vulkan descriptor pools are deliberately left unfreed after allocation errors to avoid unsafe destruction. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **GPU allocation bounds** — Checks Ganesh buffer-size arithmetic and handles CPU buffer allocation failure. Rejects oversized multisample attachments on affected Imagination GL, ANGLE and Vulkan devices rather than overflowing their footprint limits. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **Filtered images and draw ordering** — Prevents Ganesh image filters from incorporating unwritten scratch-texture texels and restricts destination reads to their bounds. Graphite resets depth tracking after full-overwrite draws to preserve painter order. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
- **FreeType LCD glyph bounds** — Corrects LCD16 bitmap coordinate conversion and cropping when successive glyph loads produce different bounds. Validates bitmap dimensions and format, and guards outline translation and image-buffer bounds. ([#5839](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5839))
